གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows ('ong gi 'comes, and')
མཚན: name (mtshan), the respectful word; also a mark, sign
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
བརྗོད: to say, to utter, to declare
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …') · from, of, with verbs of fleeing and fearing (X la bros 'flee from X')
བར་དོར: in the bardo (bar do + -r 'in, into') · as the bardo: the -r marks what a thing is recognised as (bar dor ngo shes 'recognise as the bardo')
ར་མདའ: help, rescue (ra mda' sbran: 'to call for help')
མཛོད་ཅིག: please do! (mdzod, respectful 'do!' + cig, which marks a command)
མ: not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
གསོལ་བ: prayer, request, asking (gsol ba) · the respectful word for eating and drinking: zhal du gsol ba 'putting to the mouth, eating, drinking'
ཐོབ་ཅིག: uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
ཁྲག་འཐུང: blood-drinker, blood-drinking: the name of the wrathful deities (khrag 'blood' + 'thung, the present stem of 'to drink', past btungs, imperative 'thungs; Sanskrit heruka)
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again') · at the head of a clause, de yang 'that is, that also', opening a description
མོས་བ: devotion (mos ba, the print's spelling of mos pa)
ཀྱཻ་མ: alas! a cry of lament or entreaty at the head of a prayer (kyai ma, the same cry as kye ma)
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
དྲག་པོས: by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
འཁོར་བར: in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
དངངས་སྐྲག: dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
འཇིགས་སྣང: fearful appearance, appearance of fear ('jigs 'fear' + snang 'appearance')
བཅོམ་ལྡན: Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan, short for bcom ldan 'das)
ཞི་ཁྲོའི: of the peaceful and wrathful ones (zhi khro + -'i 'of')
ཚོགས: host, crowd, gathering (tshogs) · accumulation (of merit and wisdom), what is gathered (tshogs): tshogs ma bsags pa 'who has not gathered the accumulations'
ཀྱིས: by, by means of (the 'of' particle + -s; the form used after d, b, s) · after a verb: 'but, and', running on to what follows (yod kyis 'there is, but') · in this print also written where kyi 'of' is meant (sangs rgyas kyis sku, read 'the buddha's bodies')
ལམ་སྣ: head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi) · in this print perhaps also written where kyis 'by' is meant (khyod kyi gong du, read as khyod kyis)
སྐྱོར: to hold up, to support (skyor, the present stem, which also serves as the imperative 'hold up!'; past and future bskyor)
བར་དོ: the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
འཕྲང: narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
ལས: from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
བསྒྲལ་དུ: to free, to deliver (bsgral, future stem of sgrol 'to free', + -du): bsgral du gsol 'I pray that you free'
གསོལ: to pray, to ask, to request (gsol, the humble word for 'ask'): -du gsol 'I ask that' · to wear, to put on, the respectful word for dress and ornaments (gsol): rgyan gsol 'wearing ornaments'
ཡང་དག: true, genuine, perfect (yang dag): yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'true and perfect buddha' (Sanskrit samyaksaṃbuddha)
ས་རུ: to the level, to the stage (sa 'ground, level' + -ru 'to'): the stage a buddha has reached
སྐྱོལ: bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
དང: and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
རང་སྣང: self-appearance, one's own appearance (rang 'self' + snang 'appear'): what the mind itself shows
སྟོང་པའི: of the empty, of emptiness (stong pa 'empty' + -'i 'of')
འཆར: to dawn, to arise, to appear
འདིར: here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
མི: not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
འབྱུང: to come about, to occur, to arise ('byung; byung is its past)
ཡེ་ཤེས: wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
གསལ་བའི: making clear, of clarity (gsal ba 'clear, to be clear' + -'i 'of')
འཇིགས: to fear, to be afraid ('jigs); fear
སྐྲག: to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
རང་ངོ: one's own face, its own nature (rang 'self' + ngo 'face')
ཁྲོ་བོའི: of the wrathful ones, wrathful (khro bo 'wrathful one' + -'i 'of')
སྐུ་གཟུགས: image of a deity, a statue or painting (sku 'body' + gzugs 'form')
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
མྱོང: to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
ཡི: of (the form used after a vowel, yi; also gi, kyi, gyi, -'i) · perhaps 'by', standing for yis, where the verse needs it
ཆོས་ཉིད: reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
སྟོང: empty · thousand (stong), as in 'brug stong 'a thousand thunderclaps'
རྗེས་སུ: after, following (rjes 'after' + -su 'to'): rjes su dran pa 'to recollect'
ཆེན་པོས: by the great (chen po 'great' + -s 'by'): brtse ba chen pos 'by great love'
འོད་གསལ: clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
ཁམས: realm, world, element (khams): 'jig rten gyi khams 'the realms of the world'
ཞིང: and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm' · a corpse, in these texts (zhing gi dbyug to 'a corpse as a club', zhing chen 'great field', a human corpse); taken from the words, the sense is not wholly sure
མཐོང་བར: to see, in seeing (mthong 'see' + -ba + -r): mthong bar lta bur 'like seeing'
ཅེས: so, thus: closes speech (ces, the form of zhes after g, d, b)
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་བས: because it comes to be, and so it becomes ('gyur 'become' + -ba + -s 'by, because')
ཡེངས་ཤིག: be distracted! (yengs 'to be distracted' + shig, which marks a command): ma yengs shig 'do not be distracted'
ལན: time, occasion (lan gsum: three times); also 'answer'
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l) · after a verb: 'but', marking a contrast (yin gyi 'it is so, but') · in this print perhaps also written where gyis 'by, with' is meant (dmar gyi bkang 'filled with red')
བར་དུ: until, up to (bar 'interval' + -du 'to'); after ma + verb + gyi: 'until it comes'
བརྗོད་དོ: says, is to be said (brjod, past and future of rjod 'to say', + the sentence-ending -do)
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
ལས་འཕྲོ: karmic residue (las 'karma' + 'phro 'remainder'): what is left over of past deeds and goes on working; in this text the good karma from past lives that ties a person to the teaching
ངན: bad, evil (ngan): bag chags ngan 'bad habitual tendencies'
གྲོལ: to be freed, to come free
སྲིད་དོ: can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
བྱས: did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
འཕྲོད: to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
ངོ་སྤྲོད: to point out, to introduce: to bring someone face to face with a thing so that he recognises it (ngo 'face' + sprod 'bring together')
འོག་ཏུ: after, below ('og 'below, under' + -tu 'at'): X 'das pa'i 'og tu 'after X has passed'
འཆི་ཁར: at the brink of death ('chi kha 'point of death' + -r 'at')
ཐོས་གྲོལ: liberation through hearing (thos 'hear' + grol 'be freed'); the Tibetan name of this book
གོམ་འདྲིས: familiarity through practice (goms 'to get used to' + 'dris 'well acquainted')
འཕྲོད་པ: meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
ཡོད་པ: having, there being; one who has (yod 'there is' + -pa)
འཆི་ཁའི: of the point of death ('chi kha 'the brink of death' + -'i 'of')
ཤར་བའི: of what dawned, that dawned (shar, the past stem of 'char 'dawn', + -ba + -'i 'of')
གསང་སྔགས: secret mantra, the tantric teaching (gsang 'secret' + sngags 'mantra'; Sanskrit guhyamantra)
བསྐྱེད་རྫོགས: generation and completion, the two stages of tantric meditation (bskyed 'generate' + rdzogs 'complete')
བསྒོམ་པ: meditating, meditation (bsgom, future of sgom 'to meditate', + -pa)
སྣང་བ: appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
བྱའོ: is to be done, one should (bya, future of byed 'do', + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཚིག་དོན: the words and their meaning (tshig 'word' + don 'meaning')
གསལ་བར: clearly (gsal ba + -r, which makes an adverb)
བྱུང: came about, happened, occurred (byung, past of 'byung)
བརྗེད་པར: forgetting, to forget (brjed 'forget' + -par 'to'); ma brjed par 'without forgetting'
ཆེན་མོ: great (chen 'big', with the feminine ending often used in titles)
ཞེས: so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
བྱ་བ: called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
ཐོས: heard, hears (thos 'to hear', the verb of hearing, beside nyan 'to listen')
གྲོལ་བར: to be freed, that one will be freed (grol ba + -r)
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
ཕྱིར: outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out' · back: phyir mi ldog go 'does not turn back' (phyir 'back' + ldog 'turn') · because, for the sake of (de'i phyir 'therefore', ci'i phyir 'why'; yod pa'i phyir 'because there is')
ཆེན་པོའི: of the great (chen po 'great' + -'i 'of'): byar med chen po'i ngang du 'in the state of great non-doing'
ཅིག: one, a (gcig written without its prefix g-)
དོན: meaning, point, matter; a heading or part of a text
རིག་པ: knowing, awareness itself, before any thought · as printed in yan lag rig pa, doubtful on the image and not fitting; perhaps a misprint for rags pa 'coarse, massive' (uncertain)
འགྲོ་བས: because they go, and so go ('gro 'go' + -ba + -s 'by, because')
གཅིག: one; a, a certain · perhaps 'together, at once' (as gcig 'one' in 'od drug kyang gcig 'char du 'ong 'the six lights also dawn together'); the sense is not sure
རྣ་བར: to the ear, in the ear (rna ba 'ear' + -r)
འཕྲད་པ: meeting ('phrad 'meet' + -pa): ma dang bu 'phrad pa 'mother and child meeting'
ཤིང: and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
གལ་ཏེ: if (opens a condition that na closes)
འཕྲད: to meet, to come upon ('phrad): X dang 'phrad 'to meet with X'
སྐྱེས་པ: arisen, having arisen (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise', + -pa)
ཆོས: thing, phenomenon; the teaching (Sanskrit dharma) · reality, what is true (chos): chos kyi rang sgra 'the own sound of reality'
ཐོས་པ: hearing, learning: what one has heard from teachers (thos 'to hear' + -pa): thos pa rgya mtsho 'learning like an ocean'
ཙམ: just, only, about · as much as, so much that (tsam): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'so loud as to split the head'
གྲོལ་བ: being freed, liberation (grol + ba, which makes a verb into a noun)
རི: mountain, hill (ri); where it gives no sense, perhaps a syllable set twice by mistake (uncertain)
གནས: to remain, to stay; a place · state, condition (gnas bsgyur 'changed in state')
སྟེ: and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
གཏད: aimed, directed, placed toward (past of gtod)
